other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Unsupervised Encodings on Combined Data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes unsupervised encodings (e.g., frequency encoding, group-by means and standard deviations) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of test set features into the training data.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated modeling pipeline with extensive feature engineering, target encoding, and an optimized ensemble. However, it suffers from multiple forms of data leakage by applying TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and aggregate statistics on the combined dataset before splitting. Furthermore, the use of a random K-fold split ignores the temporal nature of the project data, potentially introducing look-ahead bias.
